jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Program Manager – Railway Planning Systems
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Direct the end-to-end delivery of high-impact software programs within the transport domain.
• Orchestrate complex RFP processes and manage "buy and integrate" vendor relationships.
• Facilitate strategic roadmap development and alignment with organizational goals.
• Lead and mentor agile and scrum delivery teams to ensure operational excellence.
• Partner with C-level executives to provide program transparency and strategic insights.
• Standardize program execution using frameworks like PM², PMBOK, or SAFe.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in software delivery project management and 6+ years in program management.
• 5+ years of experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery teams.
• 2+ years of experience in the Railway Industry with a proven record in planning systems.
• You possess end-to-end experience in "buy and integrate" models and have executed multiple RFP cycles.
• You have a proven track record in strategic roadmap creation and C-level stakeholder management.
• You're proficient with project management frameworks such as PM², PMBOK, or SAFe.
• You possess professional proficiency in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Proficiency with Software Development Life Cycles (SDLC).

Responsibilities

• Map end-to-end financial flows from charging sessions to journal entries, including billing, payments, and roaming settlements.
• Translate complex tariffs, subscriptions, and promotions into functional specifications and accounting logic within the ERP.
• Produce detailed process documentation, interface contracts, and data mappings for system integrations between platforms.
• Define accounting treatments for VAT, accruals, and revenue recognition in close collaboration with finance stakeholders.
• Design automated reconciliation processes between external platforms, payment providers, and the general ledger.
• Manage the finance backlog by creating user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing delivery tasks.
• Lead functional testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure full auditability and system reliability.

Requirements

• You bring 3+ years of experience as a business or functional analyst within finance, billing, or ERP environments.
• You possess functional expertise in Odoo, specifically within the Accounting, Invoicing, and Subscriptions modules.
• You have a strong command of financial fundamentals, including AR/AP, VAT treatment, accruals, and month-end closing processes.
• You're experienced in designing controls for high-volume automated transaction flows and system reconciliations.
• You have experience with system integrations, data mapping, and defining interface contracts between platforms.
• You possess a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, economics, business engineering, or a related field.
• You're able to produce clear technical specifications and test cases that bridge the gap between business and IT.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented, capable of aligning stakeholders across finance, product, and technology departments.
• You are fluent in English with a good command of French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in usage-based billing environments such as e-mobility, energy, telecom, or payments.
• Familiarity with AMPECO or other charging point management systems (CPMS).

Responsibilities

• Lead the preparation, coordination, and monitoring of system and user acceptance testing for complex application projects.
• Coordinate a team of application experts, providing clear direction and guidance to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Integrate AI-assisted testing into the test lifecycle to improve efficiency in analysis, design, and execution.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, including project leads and business analysts, to align testing activities with business objectives.
• Monitor and report on test progress, defects, and risks while defining criteria for go/no-go decisions.
• Promote knowledge sharing and experiment with new AI tools to strengthen the overall testing capabilities of the organization.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience as a Test Manager, Test Coordinator, or in a similar quality assurance leadership role.
• Proven hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing and the ability to translate AI knowledge into practical test approaches.
• Advanced knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
• Possess an ISTQB Foundation certification or higher.
• Experience in stakeholder management and leading cross-functional teams in a structured environment.
• Strong analytical skills with a focus on problem-solving and meeting challenging deadlines.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in Dutch or French and a good level of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid project methodologies.
• Knowledge of modern test automation frameworks and AI-driven quality tools.
• Understanding of life insurance applications and business processes.
• Proficiency in French, Dutch, and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Network Security Engineer – F5 & AWAF
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain F5 infrastructure, specifically the Advanced Web Application Firewall modules.
• Install and configure F5 components including APM, ASM, and LTM for secure application delivery.
• Develop and document technical security policies and monitor their consistent application.
• Conduct technical risk analyses and implement remediation strategies to address system vulnerabilities.
• Monitor the security state of IT systems and provide rapid intervention during network intrusions or crisis situations.
• Advise on technical solutions for securing external partner connections via intranet and internet.
• Produce comprehensive technical documentation and incident reports for internal stakeholders.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in IT security with a focus on network protection and infrastructure management.
• Expertise in F5 infrastructure including F5 AWAF, APM, ASM, LTM, Identity Provider, and SSL VPN.
• Strong knowledge of network and application firewalls such as Palo Alto, Forcepoint, and Panorama.
• Advanced proficiency in network protocols and security standards including TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL, and SNMP.
• Experience using monitoring and log correlation tools such as Splunk, Nessus, or Elastic SIEM.
• Proven capability in performing technical risk analyses and vulnerability remediation.
• Demonstrated experience in security crisis management and incident response.
• Methodical and precise approach with a strong ability to document technical processes.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with at least basic knowledge of the other, and technical English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of wireless network security including WPA2 and encryption principles.
• Experience with Citrix terminal-server solutions.

Responsibilities

• Configure and develop modules for financial flows including invoicing, accounting, and subscription management.
• Build and maintain integrations between management systems for data synchronization and automated invoice generation.
• Develop interfaces for payment service providers and bank statement imports to enable automated reconciliation.
• Design robust interfaces focusing on idempotent processing, replay mechanisms, and data integrity.
• Translate functional specifications into documented code while prioritizing standard platform capabilities.
• Participate in code reviews and support deployment pipelines across development and production environments.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in Odoo development with recent versions.
• 3+ years working with Python, the Odoo ORM, PostgreSQL, and XML views.
• Experience with Odoo accounting and invoicing modules, including journals, taxes, and multi-company setups.
• Technical experience with REST APIs, XML-RPC / JSON-RPC, webhooks, and ETL.
• Knowledge of software development lifecycle tools including Git, CI/CD, and containerized environments.
• Functional understanding of accounting principles and financial reconciliation.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to technical design.
• You are fluent in English with professional proficiency in French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with OWL and front-end customization.
• Previous experience in high-volume transactional or usage-based billing environments.
• Knowledge of e-mobility or energy sector financial processes.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list.

• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

jobs.occupation: Dutch & French Speaking Banking Customer Support Officer – Relocation to Malta
jobs.description:
Working closely with the Wealth Support - Manager, you will be supporting our customers throughout their customer journey. You will be joining a fast-paced, innovative environment and a vibrant and dynamic team. We are driven by providing excellent customer service which in turn provides you with an excellent opportunity to grow and learn.Our shift hours are between 9 am and 8 pm in combination with a hybrid working model, this adds value to your personal planning and work life balance. The role also provides the opportunity to gain a professional certificate in Bank Mediation (Febelfin – Wet Willems).

The selected candidate should be willing to relocate to Malta.

Duties and responsibilities

• 

Attracting new customers by answering incoming calls and responding to customer emails

• 

Responding and resolving customer queries and escalating technical issues, whilst finding and explaining the best solution to solve the problem

• 

Providing customers with information about the Bank’s products and services

• 

Following up on customers’ instructions including payments, placement of trades, transfer of investment portfolios, and account opening and closure

• 

Supporting the Bank’s marketing strategy throughout various campaigns focusing on savings and wealth products

Required knowledge, skills and experience

• 

Native Dutch or French - Dutch/French-only speakers are also encouraged to apply. 

• 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is a plus

• 

Previous experience in a customer service role will be considered an asset

Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics
